lesson.title: Procedure 106 – RADIO STATION CALL SIGN ANNOUNCEMENT
lesson.topic: Basic Radio Dispatching – Call Sign Announcements and Zone Identifiers
objectives: Explain the FCC/Department requirement to announce station call signs every 30 minutes during continuous operation.
State when the call sign announcement must be made and use the required announcement format.
Identify CAD designations, call signs, and precinct coverage for radio zones by borough.
Identify Transit Division call signs and CAD designations.
Identify citywide frequency CAD designations and associated call signs.

questions.topic: Procedure 106 – RADIO STATION CALL SIGN ANNOUNCEMENT
questions.stem: Procedure 106: How often must radio stations be identified by their assigned call signs during continuous operation?
questions.solution: SCOPE states call signs must be announced every 30 minutes during continuous operation.
questions.hints: Look for the time interval required by FCC/Department procedure.

source.coverage: FCC/Dept requirement: identify station by call sign every 30 minutes; call signs identify zones; posted at zones; example WIF537 Zone 7 Manhattan

questions.topic: Procedure 106 – RADIO STATION CALL SIGN ANNOUNCEMENT
questions.stem: Procedure 106 requires call sign identification every 30 minutes during periods of continuous operation.

questions.topic: Procedure 106 – RADIO STATION CALL SIGN ANNOUNCEMENT
questions.stem: Procedure 106: When must the dispatcher first broadcast the time and station call sign?

choices.text: Only when requested by a unit
After the first job is dispatched
Immediately after signing into the computer terminal

questions.solution: The RADIO DISPATCHER section says to announce immediately after signing in.
questions.hints: It’s tied to logging into the terminal.

source.coverage: Broadcast time and identify station immediately after signing in; repeat at least every 30 minutes; use standard statement; examples include WIF537 Zone 7 and WIH585 Transit Division 1

questions.topic: Procedure 106 – RADIO STATION CALL SIGN ANNOUNCEMENT
questions.stem: Procedure 106 allows the dispatcher to skip the call sign announcement if the radio is busy, as long as it’s done once per hour.
questions.hints: The procedure requires at least every 30 minutes during continuous operation.

source.coverage: Broadcast time and identify station immediately after signing in; repeat at least every 30 minutes; use standard statement; examples include WIF537 Zone 7 and WIH585 Transit Division 1
